svg.data-weight-note: 24.5 lb (11.11 kg) with power supplies and fans installed (guide Table 32)
svg.data-qsfpdd-speeds: 400 GbE default; 100, 40, 25 or 10 GbE with the matching optic or breakout cable (guide, Setting Port Speed and Channelization)
svg.data-power-measurement-note: Maximum at 40 C ambient with SR optics at 100 percent load with IMIX traffic. Typical at 25 C with DACs at 50 percent load with IMIX traffic, excluding transceivers (guide Table 19)
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz; 12.7 A at 100 to 127 VAC, 9.4 A at 200 to 240 VAC (guide Table 19)
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating -40 to -72 VDC, 40 A maximum (guide Table 26)
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, 1+1, each able to carry the whole switch; both should be installed, on feeds A and B
svg.data-fans: six fan modules, 5+1; the switch runs three minutes without thermal alarm while one is replaced
svg.data-airflow-note: AFO is front-to-back (port-to-FRU); AFI is back-to-front (FRU-to-port); no mixing of fans and supplies of different direction
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) for AFO; 0 to 25 C (32 to 77 F) for AFI (guide Table 31)
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 1828.8 m (6000 ft) at 0 to 40 C for AFO and 0 to 25 C for AFI (guide Table 31)
svg.data-software: Junos OS Evolved, first release 19.1R1 (the DC build 19.3R1)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400 GbE QSFP-DD DAC, 400 GbE AOC, QSFP28 100 GbE, QSFP+ 40 GbE with breakout (guide, Network Ports)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: ports 32 and 33 take 10 GbE modules only, not 1 GbE
svg.data-ptp: clock input and output connectors for 10 MHz and 1 PPS, and an RJ-45 time-of-day port
svg.data-oob: one RJ-45 management port with link and status lamps
svg.data-timing-outputs: PPS and 10 MHz clock connectors, in and out, and an RJ-45 time-of-day port
svg.data-safety: CAN/CSA-C22.2 No. 60950-1; UL 62368-1; IEC 62368-1:2014; IEC 60950-1:2005/A2:2013 (CB scheme); EN 60825-1 (guide, Agency Approvals for the QFX Series)
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15 Class A. EN 55022 Class A. VCCI Class A. BSMI CNS 13438 Class A. AS/NZS CISPR 22 Class A. EN 55024. CISPR 24. EN 300 386. EN 61000-3-2. EN 61000-3-3. (guide, Agency Approvals for the QFX Series)
svg.data-nebs: designed to comply with Zone 4 earthquake requirements of NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 3 (guide Table 31)
